status: POST HOC (revision after the independent review, 2026-10-31); PROTOCOL-v0.3 §13 entry 11; not pre-registered

simulation.design: calibration = candidate counts (false, true) of the 125 1-mm-grid scans; test = counts of the 100 MS3SEG scans; latent scores: false = b + e, true = mu + b + e, b ~ N(0, rho), e ~ N(0, 1 - rho), mu = sqrt(2)·Phi^-1(0.80) (pooled AUROC ≈ 0.80); 'shift' is added to the TEST false scores only.

controls.p2_premise: on a lesion-free scan every candidate is false, so the scan's safe threshold always lies above its top candidate; in patients this holds only for a share of scans (see posthoc fullprec)
